answer_2.quote: We adopt the LLM-as-a-Judge for automatic evaluation... We design four novel metrics to automatically assess the quality of the generated data: Faithfulness, Novelty, Practicality, Coherence.

answer_3.quote: We adopt the LLM-as-a-Judge for automatic evaluation, due to its strong alignment with human judgments... we use a proprietary model capable of processing both visual and textual inputs. ... We also evaluate using GPT-4o.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation with 36 non-design expert annotators... they are provided with a detailed rubric using the same metrics and a 1-5 scale as automated evaluations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators used a rubric with the four metrics (Faithfulness, Novelty, Practicality, Coherence) and a 1-5 rating scale.
